title: South Florida food openings and easy plans this week
sources: Miami-Dade County Golden Ticket Arts Guide
igCaption:
Food openings and one strange car wash plan this week.
Oct 21, El Car Wash W. Flagler, free tickets while supplies last

Sources: Time Out Worldwide, PROFILEmiami, The Miami Guide, Secret Miami, Miami-Dade County Golden Ticket Arts Guide

#Miami #SouthFlorida #MiamiFood #ThingsToDoMiami

scenes.text: A grocery market backed by Major Food Group is opening in Midtown, and one car wash turns haunted this week.

Wilder is set to open in Midtown this fall. Major Food Group is backing it, with Grassfed Culture Hospitality involved, and reports describe a neighborhood market with a kitchen from the Los Félix team.
scenes.caption: Wilder is set to open in Midtown this fall. Major Food Group is backing it, with Grassfed Culture Hospitality involved, and reports describe a neighborhood market with a kitchen from the Los Félix team.

scenes.text: Mercante is coming to the Miami River this fall. Nicola Siervo is behind the Italian Riviera restaurant and piano bar.
scenes.caption: Mercante is coming to the Miami River this fall. Nicola Siervo is behind the Italian Riviera restaurant and piano bar.

scenes.text: El Car Wash on West Flagler becomes Tunnel of Terror on Wednesday, October 21, from 5 to 9 p.m. The address is 6695 W. Flagler Street, with live scare actors, red lights, a DJ, and two House of Horror tickets per car while supplies last. If you go, check NEAR afterward and see who else survived the tunnel.

scenes.text: Miami-Dade residents 62 and older can use the Golden Ticket Arts Guide for free admission to cultural events. The guide includes Miami City Ballet, Florida Grand Opera, New World Symphony, Pérez Art Museum, Freedom Tower, Deering Estate, and Fairchild Tropical Botanic Garden.
